adjudication.rationale: In lib/tasks/disqus.thor the CLI option `method_option :category, aliases: '-c'` is removed (diff shows it deleted) along with the subsequent `options[:category]` lookup and passing `category: category_id` into `PostCreator`. The importer now calls `TopicEmbed.import_remote(...)` without any category parameter. This means existing `disqus:import -c <category>` invocations will fail with an unknown-option error, and there is no longer a way for the task to place imported topics into a specified category.
